record_status.result_recorded: The record states a result; that does not prove every move was recorded.
record_status.unfinished_or_unknown: The game is unfinished or its result unknown; only recorded moves are reviewed.
flag.missing_score_evidence: Some moves lack score evidence and were not judged.
flag.missing_winrate_evidence: The winrate change is unavailable for some moves.
flag.negative_difference_search_noise: Some raw score differences are negative, likely search noise; the loss counts as 0 and is not praised.
flag.played_move_not_searched: Some played moves were not searched, so their same-root diagnostic is missing.
flag.separate_search: Some played moves' same-root diagnostic comes from a separate restricted search.
flag.low_visits: Some compared candidates had few visits; their estimates may be unstable.
flag.missing_current_value: The evaluation of the final recorded position is incomplete.
flag.no_candidate_moves: The final recorded position has no candidate moves.
flag.other: The engine reported another quality warning: {code}.
input.first_variation_only: The record has variations; only the main line is reviewed.
input.encoding_guessed: The record declares no encoding; it was read as {encoding}.
input.missing_ff: The record names no SGF version (FF).
input.missing_gm: The record names no game type (GM); it was read as Go.
input.unknown_rules: The record's rules were not recognised.
input.lossy_decode: Some characters could not be decoded and were replaced.
input.handicap_mismatch: The handicap (HA) does not match the placed stones.
report.title: Game review
report.coverage: Score loss evaluated for {with_score}/{total} moves, winrate change for {with_winrate}/{total}, ownership for {with_ownership}/{total}; mistakes found: {mistakes}.
report.partial: The report is partial: unevaluated moves cannot be taken as free of mistakes.
report.clean: At the current thresholds no recorded move is a mistake.
report.method: Rule: a sequential score loss of at least {mistake} points is a mistake, at least {severe} points severe. The thresholds are uncalibrated product settings; values are search estimates, not certainties.
report.mistake: [{severity}] Move {number}, {color} {move}: loses {loss} points; {color}'s winrate change {winrate}. Recommended {best}.
